name: Dijkstra's Shortest Path
description: Dijkstra's algorithm finds the shortest path from a source vertex to all other vertices in a weighted graph with non-negative edge weights. It greedily expands the closest unvisited vertex, updating tentative distances to its neighbors.
approach: Initialize all distances to infinity except the source (0). Use a min-heap keyed by distance. Pop the smallest, and for each neighbor relax: if dist + weight < neighbor_dist, update and push. Stop early if only a target is needed.
time_complexity: O((V + E) log V) with a binary heap
use_cases: Single-source shortest paths with non-negative weights.
common_mistakes: Applying Dijkstra with negative edge weights (use Bellman-Ford).
Skipping stale heap entries by not checking visited/distance before relaxing.
